help.bot.disabledCommands: Disabled commands. Commands the bot will not answer. Anything listed here replies that it is turned off rather than staying silent.
help.currencies.tf2.enabled: Accept TF2 keys. Turn off to stop trading in keys without changing your rates.
help.rates.tf2.buy: Sets you give for one key. How many card sets you hand over for one TF2 key. This is what a customer gets when they sell you a key.
help.rates.tf2.sell: Sets you want for one key. How many card sets a customer must give you to receive one TF2 key. Keep this at or above the buy rate or you lose sets on every round trip.
help.stock.maxPerGame: Most sets to hold per game. Once you hold this many sets of a game the bot stops buying more of it. Stops your stock filling up with one worthless game.
help.limits.maxSetsPerBuy: Most sets a customer can buy at once. Caps a single trade. A customer wanting more simply makes a second one.
help.limits.maxSetsPerSell: Most sets a customer can sell at once. Caps a single trade in the other direction.
help.limits.maxCustomerLevel: Highest customer level to serve. Above this level a customer already owns most cards, so a trade would deliver very little. 0 removes the limit.
help.filters.rejectTradeBanned: Refuse trade banned accounts. An account with a trade ban cannot complete a trade anyway.
help.filters.rejectVacBanned: Refuse VAC banned accounts. A VAC ban is about cheating in a game and says nothing about whether someone can trade, so this is off by default.
help.filters.rejectLimitedAccounts: Refuse limited accounts. A limited account has never spent money on Steam. They can still trade cards.
help.filters.minSteamLevel: Lowest customer level to accept. Turns away brand new accounts. 0 accepts everyone.
help.filters.allowTradeHolds: Trade with customers who have a hold. A trade hold means Steam keeps the items for up to 15 days before delivering them. Turning this on means waiting that long to receive what you bought.
help.providers.steamTradeX.inventoryKey: SteamTradeX inventory API key. Our own inventory reading service, from your SteamTradeX dashboard under API. Optional.
help.providers.steamTradeX.listingKey: SteamTradeX listing API key. Keeps your bot's stock and rates current on the SteamTradeX bot list. List the bot on steamtradex.com, then copy the API key from Edit Bot.
help.providers.steamTradeX.updateCatalog: Send your stock list to SteamTradeX. Nothing is sent until the listing API key above is set.
help.bot.helpLeadLine: Say who made the bot. Ends the !HELP list with one line saying this bot is the free SteamTradeX bot. Only in !HELP, never in a trade reply. Turn off to leave it out.
